dedupe_keys.name: sapi bulgaria agricultural market price bulletins weekly retail food prices by district grain bulletins and consumer basket to 2023

description: SAPI is Bulgaria's agricultural market information system, which collects and publishes food prices. Its main product is a weekly price bulletin with retail prices of food products for each district of the country, together with grain market bulletins and a consumer basket price. The bulletins are numbered, with more than 1,100 issues; the latest listed on the site date from 2023, such as bulletin No. 1124 of 4 January 2023. They are free and available to download as PDF from the SAPI site, and custom price reports are prepared on request; no licence terms are stated. Caveats: the series appears to have stopped being posted in 2023, prices are in PDF tables, not a machine-readable series, and the product list and methods are only described in the bulletins themselves. Simulation uses: tracing regional food price shocks during supply disruptions, calibrating price responses in food system models and checking the effect of past crises on food access by district. Related records: the WFP global food prices database (data-wfp-global-food-prices) gives market prices worldwide, and the World Bank real-time food prices (data-worldbank-real-time-food-prices) offer modelled estimates.
